functions.name: FORECAST
functions.description: Forecast a series a few business days ahead, using only data published by the as-of date. Spills the forecast path and its provenance.

parameters.name: horizon
parameters.description: Business days ahead (the model accepts 1 to 20).

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description: Optional as-of date: a date cell or a YYYY-MM-DD string. Leave out for the latest data.

functions.name: REGIME
functions.description: Classify the regime of a rate series on the as-of date. Spills the result and its provenance.

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description: Optional as-of date: a date cell or a YYYY-MM-DD string. Leave out for the latest data.

functions.name: TOOLS
functions.description: List the tools the gateway serves, with their descriptions.
